rules.description: Map of rule name to rule. The key is only a label for logs and never overrides another rule. All rules from the global and working-directory configs are matched and every match is redacted; overlapping matches merge into a single token, so none of their text survives.

pattern.description: JavaScript regular expression source, or an exact string when literal is true.

flags.description: Regular expression flags. The global flag (g) is always added.

literal.description: Treat pattern as a literal string instead of a regular expression.
